name: E-router

spikes.transactions: Bank or card transaction: a merchant descriptor, amount and date, with recent charges from the same merchant. Decides the spending category, whether it recurs and whether it is unusual.
spikes.emails: Email: a subject line and a body. Decides what kind of email it is, whether it needs a reply and how urgent it is.
spikes.reviews: Customer review of a business or product. Decides the star rating, the main complaint and whether the business should reply.
